summaryZh: Simeone Lab 研究胰腺癌的早期检测、进展转移、耐药机制与新治疗。近期方向结合单细胞测序、空间转录组、成像及多模态数据，研究肿瘤异质性与进展。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子机制驱动胰腺癌进展与转移？
胰腺癌治疗抵抗的机制是什么？

evidence.quote: Simeone Lab Welcome to the Simeone lab

Specific areas of focus in the laboratory include modernizing early detection and diagnostics, dissecting the molecular mechanisms that drive progression and metastasis, defining mechanisms of therapeutic resistance
combining single cell-sequencing and spatial transcriptomics to study PDAC clonal heterogeneity and progression, utilizing advanced imaging technologies to study cancer cell signaling
integrating multimodal data for early detection of pancreatic cancer.
Moores Cancer Center Moores Cancer Center UC San Diego
Kipps Lab Patel Lab Simeone Lab

Specific areas of focus in the laboratory include modernizing early detection and diagnostics, dissecting the molecular mechanisms that drive progression and metastasis, defining mechanisms of therapeutic resistance, and developing new, more effective therapies for pancreatic cancer.
